mentions.name: Name Brewery
mentions.description: This MCP server lets an LLM look up domain name availability, so name brainstorming and registrar checks can happen directly inside an LLM conversation.
mentions.problem: Registrar lookups for brainstormed names previously had to be done outside the LLM.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://namebrewery.com: An MCP for looking up domain name availability. Brainstorming names within the LLM has been great and now I can have it do the registrar look ups from within the LLM too.
